Protection from white
{B}: This creature gains first strike until end of turn.
{B}{B}: This creature gets +1/+0 until end of turn.

recipe_coverage: Reviewed defensive component: normal casting and structured Oracle base characteristics, legal combat declarations, friendly and opposing spell targeting, colored and colorless combat damage, indestructible destruction and zero toughness, untargeted damage and destruction, cleanup, caller-owned snapshots replayed after AI backups, populated owned zones and ordered libraries. Activated abilities, flash timing, protection enchantment restrictions, sacrifice, and dynamic gain/loss of defensive abilities remain gaps. Component coverage, not whole-card certification.
